Our sustainable packaging initiatives reduce waste and make it easier for customers to remove products from packaging.
Unlike traditional retail stores, products bought online don’t need the elaborate packaging used for displaying products
on store shelves. Instead, customers use star ratings and reviews to guide their online shopping decisions.
Our Frustration-Free Packaging (FFP) program encourages manufacturers to package their products in easy-to-open
packaging that is 100% recyclable and ready to ship to customers without additional Amazon boxes. Since 2015,
we have reduced the weight of outbound packaging by 33% and eliminated more than 900,000 tons of packaging
material, the equivalent of 1.6 billion shipping boxes.
